tests.requirement: One authenticated merchant request creates an AgentRun with parallel brand, catalogue-draft, storefront, image and offer tasks; run/task state, current step and progress visible via API and status stream
tests.evidence: integration-tests/http/m2-durable-generation.spec.ts › M2-T01 (brand/catalogue overlap asserted; SSE queued→running→completed with steps)

tests.requirement: Worker killed and restarted mid-run: run resumes via lease expiry; completed tasks and completed tool calls are not repeated (idempotency keys)
tests.evidence: M2-T02a (expired lease re-claimed, replayed AIAction unchanged, stale lease holder fenced out); M2-T02b (real `medusa exec` worker SIGKILLed mid-run, in-process worker resumes, succeeded actions not re-executed, no duplicate drafts/profiles/deployments); M2-T02c (stale run status and stranded paused tasks healed by the sweep)

tests.requirement: Injected failure in one task leaves other tasks' results intact; retrying the failed task succeeds
tests.evidence: M2-T03 (catalogue fails after 3 attempts, brand/storefront completed, dependants waiting, merchant retry completes without duplicates, raw error not exposed)

tests.requirement: Follow-up prompt during a running run is queued (PromptQueue) and processed in order; cancel and pause transitions behave per state machine
tests.evidence: M2-T04 (ordered routing and supersession; crashed 'processing' prompt recovered without re-routing or duplicate tasks; cancel before/while running; pause while running does not burn an attempt; resume completes; brand follow-up also rebuilds storefront; product-change follow-up rejected as unsupported_request); M2-T04b (pause and resume during an in-flight model call neither strands nor burns the task); M2-T04c (slow follow-up is leased: second worker cannot route it again, unique (prompt_id, task_key))

tests.requirement: Every persistent change is a validated tool call with an AIAction audit row (tool, risk, actor, run/task, idempotency key, result)
tests.evidence: M2-T05 (every AI product has a matching succeeded catalogue.create_product_draft action; actor carries user/provider/model/run/task)

tests.requirement: Invalid, extra-field or out-of-schema model output is rejected with no side effects
tests.evidence: M2-T06 (extra store_environment_id and stock fields rejected, non-retryable, no actions/generations/profile/config change); unit ai-contracts strict schema cases

tests.requirement: Runs, tasks, actions, generations and business profiles are StoreEnvironment-owned; Store B run/task ids through Store A merchant API, status stream and tools are not found
tests.evidence: M2-T07 (9 foreign routes incl. SSE → 404 without leakage; row-level environment check; staff can read but not generate/cancel/upload)

tests.requirement: Prompt injection (model output naming store_environment_id or another store's product/project ids) cannot select or touch another store
tests.evidence: M2-T08 (tenant selectors in body refused before a run exists; injection text stays data; selector args, unknown tools, unstated prices, foreign media/products and risk above AI_MAX_AUTO_RISK rejected; other store unchanged)

tests.requirement: AI-generated products are drafts, invisible through the Store API and preview storefront until confirmation; provenance recorded; no invented prices or stock
tests.evidence: M2-T09 (draft status, claimed, provenance, merchant prices only, model-claimed price discarded, manage_inventory false, Store API list/get hidden); M2-T11 (draft titles absent from built preview)

tests.requirement: Generated storefront config validates against storefront-schema v2; invalid config is rejected
tests.evidence: M2-T10 (over-length and extra-field home copy rejected before an audit row; low-contrast palette replaced by validated platform colours); M2-T01 config schema_version 2

tests.requirement: E2E: generation triggers a real preview deployment that renders the generated brand and sections for its own store only
tests.evidence: integration-tests/e2e/m2-generation-e2e.spec.ts (two stores, real storefront-core 0.2.0 build, typography/accent/hero/about rendered, other store's content and own drafts absent)

tests.requirement: Images per D2 decision: tenant-prefixed storage, type/size validation, cross-store file ids rejected (TENANCY §12 media invariant)
tests.evidence: M2-T12 (key prefixed by environment, traversal filename ignored, media_file ownership, type/signature/base64/size/selector rejections, foreign media id 404, unauthenticated 401)

tests.requirement: Run budgets (tokens/time/tool calls/concurrency) enforced per D8 defaults
tests.evidence: M2-T13 (active run, daily runs, prompt size, model calls, tokens, tool calls per task, run deadline, follow-ups)

tests.requirement: Preview deployments execute through the durable worker, replacing M1 in-process execution; M1 deployment isolation tests still pass
tests.evidence: M2-T14 (request_key idempotency, live lease not stolen, expired lease recovered, a real stale holder running runLeasedDeployment after re-claim cannot overwrite the result, newest ready kept); m1-storefront-project.spec.ts and m1-preview-e2e.spec.ts green. Note: execution is leased and crash-recoverable, but the M1 `storefront.deployment.queued` subscriber still triggers the leased build in the requesting process; there is no deployment heartbeat (fixed 15-minute lease).
